## cd8b5598bb80

**Issue found — the default distribution deletes all negative structure needed to identify “exactly a straight length-4 component.”** Across 100 draws in each difficulty (300 grids total), every generated cyan component had size 4, every grid used only colors 0/8, and no grid mixed horizontal and vertical segments. The canonical examples are materially broader: they contain horizontal and vertical targets in the same grid, cyan components/runs of sizes 3, 5, 7, and 8 that must remain unchanged, and distractor colors 3/4/6/7.

A plausible generated-data shortcut is: “choose the cyan orientation present in this grid and recolor the endpoints of every maximal cyan run,” without checking that a 4-connected object is a straight component of exactly four cells. That shortcut fits the sampled generator manifold but fails canonical pair 1 by recoloring the endpoints of the vertical length-5 cyan component. A second concrete validator defect is that a grid containing only one horizontal length-3 cyan component returns `[]` from `self_check`.

The generator should mix target orientations within examples, add non-target cyan components/runs and non-cyan distractors matching canonical morphology, and make `self_check` validate component size/shape/separation rather than only the palette.

triage.reason: Audits cd8b5598bb80 canonical-length/support and c0d024631f9e dead-color/placement controls retained with hashes; targets unchanged.
